sources.title: Aya Expanse 8B model card
sources.evidence: Identifies Aya Expanse 8B, its developer, nominal 8 billion parameters, open weights, 23 supported languages, text input/output, autoregressive Transformer architecture, 8K context, and license with acceptable-use requirements. Reopened October 27: the exact card still explicitly states 8 billion parameters, describes post-training of the Command family without naming an exact checkpoint base, and supplies no active-parameter count.

sources.title: Aya Expanse: Connecting our world
sources.evidence: Launch announcement explicitly dated October 24, 2024. The currently rendered page retains the dated title and launch statement but omits most article body.

sources.title: A Deepdive into Aya Expanse: Advancing the Frontier of Multilinguality
sources.publisher: Cohere For AI team, hosted by Hugging Face
sources.evidence: First-party guest post dated October 24, 2024 explicitly releases both Aya Expanse 8B and 32B as open weights and identifies the Aya Expanse family.

sources.title: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier
sources.evidence: December 2024 technical report confirms nominal 8B, the Aya Expanse instruction-tuned family, and 8K training context for the 8B model. Section 3 specifies SwiGLU, RoPE and grouped-query attention. It describes user/chatbot formatting and evaluates mathematical reasoning, without defining active-parameter counts or a dedicated thinking mode. Fresh full report fetched October 27 and independently inspected: Sections 2–3 describe post-training/model merging of Command-series bases; the 39B active count in Section 4.1 belongs to Mixtral 8x22B, not Aya Expanse. Its comparison tables do not define an Aya Expanse active count.

sources.title: Official checkpoint public metadata and chat template
sources.publisher: Hugging Face metadata for Cohere Labs checkpoint
sources.evidence: At revision 5062468bf9bc0c6035fd64e06274333ec127d980, exposes CohereForCausalLM/model_type cohere, gated auto access, CC-BY-NC-4.0, four safetensors shards, and a default template allowing an optional system message followed by alternating user/assistant turns. No tool schema, tool-result role, or thinking switch is implemented. Aggregate safetensors metadata reports 8,028,033,024 F16 elements; individual tensor names/shapes were inaccessible. October 27 public API refresh returned HTTP 200 with the same revision, architecture class and 8,028,033,024 aggregate; this is not substituted for the developer’s nominal 8B.

sources.title: CohereForCausalLM implementation, Transformers v4.45.2
sources.evidence: Cohere-authored implementation for the exact model class reported by checkpoint metadata uses causal decoder layers with attention and ordinary dense gated MLP projections; no expert router or conditional experts. This establishes dense Transformer structure without transferring another checkpoint size.

sources.evidence: The exact c4ai-aya-expanse-8b row retains its nominal 8B, text modality, 8k context and 4k maximum output, and marks the hosted model retired April 4, 2026. These are documented specifications, not evidence of an operating endpoint.

sources.title: Aya Vision: Advancing the Frontier of Multilingual Multimodality
sources.evidence: Fresh full report fetched and independently inspected October 27. Section 4.1 names Command R7B with the Aya Expanse post-training recipe for Aya Vision 8B, and Aya Expanse 32B for Aya Vision 32B. It does not identify Aya Expanse 8B as the Vision 8B backbone or publish an active count for Expanse 8B; its parameter-efficiency figure does not establish an activated-parameter convention.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Fresh full report fetched and independently inspected October 27. Table 2 gives Tiny Aya 3.35B total and 2.8B non-embedding parameters; these counts refer to Tiny Aya, not Aya Expanse 8B. Expanse appears in the references, without an exact-model active-parameter comparison row.

sources.title: Command A: An Enterprise-Ready Large Language Model
sources.evidence: Fresh full v2 PDF fetched October 27 and independently inspected from its extracted text. Aya Expanse is cited as prior work; no Expanse 8B active/activated-parameter count or exact named-base lineage is disclosed.

sources.title: Command R7B Arabic: A Small, Enterprise Focused, Multilingual, and Culturally Aware Arabic LLM
sources.evidence: Fresh full report fetched and independently inspected October 27. Discusses Aya Expanse as multilingual post-training prior work, without identifying Expanse 8B as its base or supplying an Expanse 8B active count.

sources.title: Gold vs. Translation: Are We Measuring Language, Knowledge, or Locality
sources.evidence: October 27 search snippet exposed a Table 23 row aya-expanse-8b with total 8 and active 8, using a convention that distinguishes totals only for MoE models. Direct PDF request returned HTTP 403 and browser access returned a verification challenge. The full table, authorship and provenance could not be inspected; this lead is not accepted as a developer disclosure.

developer.note: The report names Cohere For AI and Cohere as developers; Cohere Labs is the current research-lab name.

family.note: The release explicitly names the Aya Expanse family, including this 8B member.

release_date.note: Both contemporaneous first-party launch articles carry this day. The December technical-report date is later.

open_weights.note: Released weights are available subject to the repository access conditions and noncommercial license.

license.note: Version 4.0 is explicit; the linked license also includes an Acceptable Use Addendum.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact card and original report confirm Cohere’s nominal 8B total. Public metadata still reports 8.028033024B F16 elements; prior gated-header limitations remain, but an exact census is not required to retain the published nominal count. General Command-family lineage does not warrant substituting a different checkpoint’s size.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/activated/base searches and independently inspected original Expanse plus later Aya Vision, Tiny Aya, Command A and Command R7B Arabic reports found no developer-published active count or applicable convention for Expanse 8B. The original report’s 39B active figure belongs to Mixtral; Tiny Aya’s non-embedding count and Vision 8B’s Command R7B backbone do not establish this model’s count. An inaccessible OpenReview table snippet suggests 8B active, but its provenance cannot be verified. Dense architecture alone is not used to infer active equals total.

architecture.note: Dense autoregressive decoder Transformer: the exact checkpoint declares CohereForCausalLM, whose implementation has dense MLP layers without expert routing. The exact-model report specifies SwiGLU, RoPE and GQA.

context_window.note: Retains the catalog’s nominal 8K normalization. First-party report and exact API-model row both say 8K/8k; this is not an independently verified exact 8,000-position checkpoint limit, because config access is gated.

modalities.note: The exact model card and API row specify text input and output.

reasoning.note: The published model uses ordinary instruction-chat generation with no thinking channel or reasoning-mode switch in its exact template. False refers to a dedicated reasoning mode; the report does evaluate mathematical reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: The exact released template supports system/user/assistant text only, enforces alternating user/assistant turns, and implements no tool definitions, tool-call serialization or tool-result role. This describes native template support, not arbitrary prompted text generation.

description.value: Open-weight multilingual instruction model for text generation in 23 languages.

patch.notes: 8B is Cohere’s nominal total; Hub metadata lists 8,028,033,024 F16 elements, without an independent learned-tensor census. Cohere has not separately specified an active-parameter count. Context is the documented nominal 8K. The license includes an Acceptable Use Addendum. The released template has no dedicated thinking mode or native tool-call format. Cohere retired the hosted c4ai-aya-expanse-8b endpoint on April 4, 2026; the open-weight release remains documented.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained Cohere’s nominal 8B total and an undisclosed active count after reopening the exact card/API/config, searching total/active/lineage claims, and independently inspecting the original report plus four later Cohere reports. No applicable active-count convention or exact count-bearing base inference was established. The 8.028033024B public aggregate and prior gated-header limitations are preserved; unrelated audited fields and patch values are unchanged.
